subject: GLX Station Area Resident Parking Pilot
overview: The commission approved a resident permit parking pilot program for neighborhoods surrounding the new Green Line Extension stations and authorized several bicycle infrastructure projects to improve safety and connectivity.

items.title: GLX Neighborhood Resident Permit Parking Pilot
items.summary: Approved a resident permit parking pilot program for all unrestricted public ways within approximately a quarter-mile of the new Green Line Extension stations, effective September 15, 2022.

items.title: Winthrop Street Bike Lanes Phase I
items.summary: Approved the installation of buffered bike lanes and two speed tables on Winthrop Street from the Winchester line to Lawrence Road, featuring a modified intersection design at Playstead Road to improve traffic calming.

items.title: Steve Miller Drive Bike Lane
items.summary: Approved a new inbound bike lane on Steve Miller Drive to provide a dedicated cycling connection for students and staff accessing Medford High School.

items.title: Main Street Northbound Bike Lane
items.summary: Approved an interim northbound bike lane on Main Street near the police and fire headquarters to improve the connection between Medford Square and the Green Line Extension.

items.title: No Turn on Red Restrictions at Forest Street and Lawrence Road
items.summary: Approved 'No Turn on Red' restrictions for vehicles turning from Forest Street onto Lawrence Road and vice versa to enhance pedestrian safety following a recent accident.
